free_tier.stated: no self-serve free tier: an organization is created only after emailing contact@umans.ai, and credits are bought by adding a card in the Wallet; each member gets a key and an optional monthly limit

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: the umans CLI (umans claude) and an OpenAI-compatible key at api.code.umans.ai/v1
chaining: pairs with coding agents through a team key; the scarce link is the email-to-provision organization and a card-funded balance

limits.value: optional per-member monthly limits; pay-per-token draws from a shared organization balance

binding_note: no free allowance, so a card-funded balance binds first

identity_cost.detail: the organization is created by emailing contact@umans.ai and credits are bought by adding a card in Wallet; no self-serve free signup is documented

reliability_note: no reliability event stated on the first-party page

evidence.proved: an organization is provisioned by emailing the vendor
evidence.quote: Email [contact@umans.ai](mailto:contact@umans.ai) with the email of your first admin. We create the organization and invite them.

evidence.proved: credits are bought by adding a card in Wallet
evidence.quote: In **Wallet**, add a card and buy credits. Every key of the organization draws from this one balance.

notes: org provisioning needs a human email exchange and a card; no free inference offer appears on the page.
